Maya Ortiz: Quick heads-up — I'm scheduling an "Integration Clinic" for Cohort A (webhook retries, auth scopes, dedupe). Plan: 60m workshop + 30m optional 1:1s. Proposed slots: Tue 10-11am PT, Wed 2-3pm PT, Thu 8-9am APAC-friendly. Who can lead demos? @Tom @Priya :point_up:
Tom Nguyen: I can lead Tue 10am PT. Will demo webhook replay flow + retry header. :white_check_mark:
Anya Patel: Wed 2pm ok for me — I can cover token scoping, KMS notes, and policy examples.
Priya Shah: Tue works for me too. I can co-lead the replay/dedupe section and prepare a 2-pager runbook.
Derek (sched-bot): Quick update — poll created: https://poll.link/abc123  (please respond by EOD Fri) :calendar:
Maya Ortiz: Draft agenda:
- 10m intro & goals
- 15m webhook auth walkthrough (Anya)
- 15m replay + dedupe patterns (Tom + Priya)
- 10m Q&A
- 10m 1:1 signup / logistics
Also plan to capture renewal-risk signals during 1:1s (low usage, error spikes).
Tom Nguyen: tiny ask — bring sample logs for dedupe demo. Example curl for replay:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/replay -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPLAY" -d '{"id":"abc-123"}'
```
Maya Ortiz: @eng-platform — any infra constraints if we run 3 parallel 1:1s on a dedicated pool? cc @Derek
eng-platform: We need 24h notice to spin up an extra dedicated pool. Tue 10 is fine if request submitted today. Also set concurrency cap to 2 per-demo to avoid noisy-neighboring.
Priya Shah: I'll drop the runbook draft + slot signup sheet in #cs-calendar after poll closes. Will also add a short "what to bring" checklist.
Anya Patel: Request — can we add a 5-question renewal-risk checklist to the 1:1 template? quick boolean flags (low usage, stalled rollout, data concerns, security questions, exec engagement).
Maya Ortiz: Love it — please add that to the template. Final ask: if you can't attend, reply with one line "can lead" or "backup" so I can assign backups. Thanks! :sparkles:
